definitions.explanation: Having no equal — so outstanding that nothing can be compared to it. A formal, literary word used as a suffix-like element after another noun to praise its surpassing quality, as in {正確|せいかく}{無比|むひ} (matchlessly accurate) or {勇猛|ゆうもう}{無比|むひ} (unrivaled in bravery).

examples.japanese: {正確|せいかく}{無比|むひ}の{時計|とけい}。
{彼|かれ}は{勇猛|ゆうもう}{無比|むひ}の{戦士|せんし}だった。
examples.english: He was a warrior of peerless bravery.

examples.japanese: この{剣|つるぎ}は{切|き}れ{味|あじ}が{鋭利|えいり}{無比|むひ}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: This sword is said to be of unmatched sharpness.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{演奏|えんそう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{精妙|せいみょう}{無比|むひ}で、{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}を{魅了|みりょう}した。
examples.english: His playing technique was of unparalleled subtlety and captivated the audience.

notes:
Composed of {無|む} (without) + {比|ひ} (compare, comparison). Literally 'without comparison' — nothing can be held up beside it. A formal, somewhat archaic-flavored word most at home in written praise, historical narration, advertising copy, and fixed four-character compounds.

USAGE PATTERN:
{無比|むひ} is rarely used alone. It almost always appears as the second half of a compound after a descriptive noun, in the pattern X{無比|むひ}, meaning 'matchlessly X' or 'of unparalleled X.' The resulting compound behaves as a な-adjective or の-adjective.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {正確|せいかく}{無比|むひ}: unparalleled in accuracy
- {勇猛|ゆうもう}{無比|むひ}: unrivaled in bravery
- {鋭利|えいり}{無比|むひ}: matchlessly sharp
- {強力|きょうりょく}{無比|むひ}: of unmatched power
- {精巧|せいこう}{無比|むひ}: of unparalleled craftsmanship
- {精妙|せいみょう}{無比|むひ}: of unmatched subtlety
- {冷酷|れいこく}{無比|むひ}: unrivaled in cruelty

REGISTER:
Literary and formal. Often found in product descriptions, historical writing, martial-arts and sword literature, and old-fashioned narration. In everyday conversation, a speaker would use phrases like {比|くら}べ{物|もの}にならない ('nothing to compare it to') or {他|ほか}に{類|るい}を{見|み}ない ('unlike any other') instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無類|むるい}: peerless, unrivaled — very close in meaning; more often used alone as {無類|むるい}の〜 ('a peerless 〜').
- {無双|むそう}: matchless, incomparable — also literary; famous from game titles and historical narratives.
- {比類|ひるい}ない: having no equal — a near-equivalent expression that works as an ordinary adjective.
